about.heading: About Bloom Recruiting and HR
about.body: Bloom Recruiting and HR was built for startups that are ready to grow but don't have a recruiting team yet. We step in to design your hiring process, from job descriptions and structured interviews to scorecards, set up the tools and automations that keep it moving, and put metrics in place so you can see what's working. On the HR side, we make sure every new hire has a smooth start, and we're there to advise when tougher situations come up, like corrective action or a performance plan.
highlights: 12+ years in talent acquisition and HR
Specialty in tech, high-ticket sales and marketing roles
Recruiting departments built from the ground up
Onboarding, offer letters and employee handbooks
